title: Fix Zero-Config Matrix on Windows: wasmer cranelift does not compile there
goal: windows-cpu leg fails compiling wasmer-compiler-cranelift (compile_error: backend unsupported on Windows). Gate the cranelift/backend feature per-target so the windows smoke build uses a supported backend or excludes wasmer, making the 3-OS matrix green on main instead of paying ~15min x3 per merge for a known failure.
